text:
elaine: heads up — noticed a p99 spike right after the 11:05 deploy on routes that mix long prompts + tool calls. p50 unchanged, p95 up ~10%, p99 ~3x. :eyes:
infra-bot: deploy v2026.03.11 to us-west-2 completed at 11:04:58 by ci/pipeline #8123
ben: can you paste the perf profile/traces? especially kernel selection + microbatch sizes per request bucket
elaine: pasting a short aggregated snippet from the perf capture (ns/op per step + microbatch dist):
```
agg_profile:
  kernels:
    fused_attn: mean=1.9ms p99=12.4ms
    tiled_attn: mean=2.1ms p99=4.8ms
    matmul_slowpath: mean=5.5ms p99=45.2ms
  microbatch_sizes: 1: 62%, 2: 18%, 4: 11%, 8+: 9%
  kv_hit_rate: 42% (per-request variance high)
  tail_examples: many tool-call flows where generation loop hits repeated open-ended tool queries
```
sachin: looks like kernel-choice thrash: small batches prefer fused_attn but when microbatch merges to 4/8 we flip to tiled or sometimes the slow matmul_slowpath if quant params differ. switching cost + queueing creates long tails. KV hit-rate variance changes execution path (cache refill + kv-copy costs) so scheduling oscillates.
ben: so it's not a single bad request size, it's variance that causes kernel re-selection and some requests get unlucky switching mid-flight? :thinking:
elaine: yeah — requests with long prompts + tool calls often produce variable seq growth (tool payloads appended) and sometimes accumulate microbatch >4 mid-inference. runtime currently picks kernel per-request batch at start of step, but the schedule/backpressure doesn't smooth across short time windows.
maria: mitigation ideas: clamp max microbatch per-device for low-latency tiers, and add a short smoothing window for kernel selection so we prefer the lower-p99 kernel when distribution unstable. also consider KV-hit-aware batching: keep KV-heavy requests on a dedicated lane.
kevin: to add, tool-calling loops are contributing because they produce unpredictable additional decoding steps. we should treat tool-call states as variable-length with a higher tail expectation and avoid mixing them with regular short-chat workloads. maybe route tool-calls to a separate worker pool with looser throughput SLOs.
sachin: quick experiment suggestion: 1) run with kernel-selection hysteresis (require 2 consecutive steps before switching), 2) clamp microbatch size for p99-sensitive routes to 2, 3) mark tool-call requests as KV-hot and pin to pool. run for 1 hour smoke and compare p99.
ben: can you share the config snippet you propose?
sachin: proto config we used in local repro: 
```
batching:
  max_microbatch: 2
  kernel_hysteresis_steps: 2
routing:
  lanes:
    - name: lowlatency
      match: route in ["/chat", "/completion"] except tool_call==true
      max_microbatch: 2
    - name: toolcalls
      match: tool_call==true
      max_microbatch: 8
      kv_priority: high
```
elaine: ran quick A/B on staging for 30min with hysteresis=2 + clamp microbatch=2 for lowlatency. p95 unchanged, p99 dropped ~45% on problematic route. CPU/GPU util fell a bit but acceptable for SLA. :thumbsup:
kevin: nice. question: does hysteresis add latency for steady-state larger batches? e.g., when we actually want tiled kernel for big batches, do we delay switching?
sachin: yes small added decision delay but bounded to hysteresis_steps * step_ms. for our workload p99 win > steady-state penalty. we can make hysteresis adaptive by only enabling it when variance metric > threshold.
maria: operational note: add a per-route regression monitor to alert when p99 delta > 20% after rollout. include kernel-switch rate and kv_hit_rate in the alert payload.
ben: action items?
elaine: 1) sachin to land kernel hysteresis + config flags behind feature flag (ETA 1 day) 2) ben to push lane routing + clamp on canary routes (ETA 2 days) 3) kevin to run targeted tool-call pool experiment (ETA 3 days) 4) maria to add p99 regression dashboard + alerts (ETA 2 days)
sachin: I'll also add an instrumentation tag for "kernel_switch_count" per-request so we can correlate with tail traces.
elaine: I'll attach repro scripts and a small set of long-prompt+tool-call traces to the ticket. TY all.
ben: great follow-up — keep this thread for rollout notes.
infra-bot: canary deploy queued for 12:30 window with feature-flag true (will auto-rollback on >10% p99 regression).
